items.question: Why is there water left inside?
items.answer: Filter blockage, drain pump failure, hose position or kitchen siphon problems are common causes. Common service areas include the city center, Khimshiashvili, New Boulevard, Boni, Airport area and Gonio.

items.question: Will descaler solve poor washing?
items.answer: Only if scale is the cause; it will not fix circulation, heating or pump faults.

items.question: What should I do if it leaks?
items.answer: Stop the cycle, shut off water if possible, and avoid restarting before diagnostics.

items.question: Repair the dishwasher or buy a new one?
items.answer: For machines under 7–8 years old, repair is usually cheaper than replacement: pump, heater or seal work costs far less than a new unit. After diagnostics the technician shows the faulty part and says honestly if repair is not worth it.
